title: Ya rab hussain jaisa
body:
ya rab hussain jaisa koi bewatan na ho
zainab ki tarha koi aseer e mehan na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
athara bhaiyon ki behen tanha hogayi
barbaad is tarha se kisi ka chaman na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
majboor itni hogayi shabbir ki behen
lachaar aisi khalq mein koi behen na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
halchal sipaahe shaam mein hai sibte mustafa
ghodon ki zad pe laasha e ibne hassan na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghusl o kafan na de saki jo apne bhai ko
majboor do jahan mein koi behne na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
godhi mein apne baap ki paikan se shaheed
asghar ki tarha doosra ghuncha dahan na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya is se zyada hogi ghareebi o bekasi
uryan ho laashe aur mayassar kafan na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis anees gham ki hai purse ke waaste
nauha wo kya ke dard ka jis mein sukhan na ho
ya rab hussain jaisa...
author: Anees
